question: Retrieve the names of players who scored no less than 100 runs in a match while playing for the team that lost that match.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM batsman_scored bs
JOIN ball_by_ball bbb ON bs.match_id = bbb.match_id AND bs.over_id = bbb.over_id AND bs.ball_id = bbb.ball_id AND bs.innings_no = bbb.innings_no
JOIN player_match pm ON bbb.match_id = pm.match_id AND bbb.striker = pm.player_id
JOIN match m ON pm.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN player p ON pm.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE pm.team_id != m.match_winner
GROUP BY bbb.striker, pm.team_id, pm.player_id, m.match_id, p.player_name
HAVING SUM(bs.runs_scored) >= 100
ORDER BY p.player_name
